Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Head of AI Software Development
.
Business:
CTO Platforms
Job ID
：
37152
Principal Responsibilities
As a Director of AI Software Development, you will be a key technical leader responsible for executing the transformation of how the group develops software from inception to completion. You will lead and a grow a team of engineers to augment, transform and automate engineering product with AI capabilities that can be leveraged at scale by engineers across the group, fostering an engineering culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence.
Your role will involve collaborating with product managers and cross-functional teams to shape strategy, define goals, and deliver engineering solutions. You'll be instrumental in problem-solving, making critical technical decisions, quality assurance, and evaluating emerging technologies to improve software development processes and outcomes.
Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications
Key Experience:
To be successful in this role you should have proven experience within the Technology sector with knowledge of the following:
L eading an engineering organisation, recruiting, inspiring and empowering developers with world-class technology, practice, and organisational enablement.
Transformation of developer products across the software development lifecycle, partnering with existing teams to embed AI within our products, in order to uplift both the engineering experience and productivity of our teams.
Strong Technical Background: In-depth knowledge of software design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and system architecture.
Experience with application of AI to software development patterns and processes to transform the way teams build products at scale
Evaluation and integrating: Evaluating AI proof of concepts in a standardised way, and iterating use cases through pilot phases to integrate with production products.
Product and Project Management: Experience in managing software development products and projects, including planning, resource allocation, and delivery.
Budgets and financial management: Ability to deliver to financial and commercial performance and hands-on experience of managing budgets and costs.
Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to address complex technical challenges effectively.
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical concepts at all levels of the organisation.
Decision-Making: Demonstrated ability to make critical technical decisions and trade-offs while considering project constraints and business objectives.
Collaboration: Strong teamwork and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
Key Technical Skills
Programming Languages: Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, Golang, JavaScript or Ruby.
Software Architecture: Strong knowledge and experience in designing scalable, maintainable, and modular software architectures.
Deep technical and hands-on expertise with cloud platform technologies e.g., GCP, AWS, Alibaba cloud.
AI: Demonstrable experience of developing with AI, and using agents to augment and transform the software development process at scale
Controls: Demonstratable experience of working with IT controls, and automation of control compliance within products.
Audit: Build relationships and communicate with risk stewards, infosec and compliance partners to ensure close and continuous management of AI related change and risk factors
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

Principal Responsibilities
Own the end-to-end technical design and delivery of Decision Hub capabilities (eligibility, arbitration, offering services, monitoring, APIs, etc.).
Champion and lead the adoption of AI-assisted development practices (e.g., GitHub Copilot, generative AI for code/test generation) to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and foster a culture of innovation.
Spearhead the integration of Generative AI, adaptive models, and other emerging AI technologies into the platform's core capabilities, moving beyond traditional ML models to create a truly intelligent system.
Collaborate with Product, Solution Architecture, Data, and Security to ensure compliance with regulatory controls, data lineage, and auditability.
Drive performance, scalability, and resilience design; validate via capacity/performance testing and production dry runs.
Translate business requirements into extensible, maintainable technical solutions and reference designs for multi-market reuse.
Lead technical design and code reviews, setting the standard for high-quality, efficient, and maintainable code.
Hands-on implementation and troubleshooting; unblock teams during critical incidents and deployment windows.
Coach and grow engineering capability; set engineering practices, quality metrics, and a high-performance culture.
Requirements
8+ years in software engineering with 3+ years in technical lead or architect roles on distributed, real-time systems.
Proven experience designing and delivering decisioning, orchestration, or real-time personalization platforms (or equivalent large-scale event/streaming systems).
Strong cloud design and development experience (GCP preferred; AWS/Azure acceptable) and familiarity with multi-cloud/on-prem tradeoffs.
Hands-on experience with the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle (MLOps), from model integration and deployment to performance monitoring and feedback loops.
A strong passion for and practical experience with leveraging AI development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeWhisperer) and embedding them into team workflows.
Deep knowledge of performance engineering, capacity planning, fault tolerance, and observability (APM, metrics, tracing, alerting).
Hands-on with modern engineering practices: microservices, APIs, CI/CD, infra as code, automated testing, security controls.
Excellent stakeholder skills: ability to translate complex technical concepts for business partners and influence product and delivery decisions.

jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
We are seeking an Associate to join our Financial Institutions Group within Global Corporate Banking. This role involves working with a high-performing team that covers some of the most important client relationships in the organization, spanning sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Broker Dealers and Leasing companies. You will manage relationships with large financial institutions worldwide, helping clients achieve their goals in financing, risk management, capital and liquidity management, and investments. Our clients benefit from dedicated coverage by experienced FIG team who leverages JPMorgan Chase's extensive product platform and global presence in over 60 countries.
Job Responsibilities
Support FIG bankers to build, develop and manage client relationships
Develop forward looking new business plans for clients and support existing business relationships
Conduct comprehensive client analyses to identify needs that can be addressed with JPMorgan's wide range of banking products, including equity and debt capital markets, risk management, treasury and securities services, markets and asset management
Collaborate with lines of business partners, including Debt Capital Markets, Markets, Payments, Investor Services, Asset Management, and Investment Bank, to enhance client coverage
Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills
FIG relationship management background with capability to build and develop Financial Institutions client relationships, win new business, close transactions and develop networks, both internally and externally
Prefer FIG related working experience with 3 years+
Solid knowledge of credit and commercial banking products
Strong commercial judgment and partnership skills
Understanding of flow derivatives, FX, commodities, transaction banking and securities processing would be very helpful
Strong influencing skills and proven track record of managing cross cultural environment
The ability to read and speak English and Mandarin is a prerequisite
ABOUT US
J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
About The Team
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

jobs.title: Head of Trade Working Capital China and Head of Trade Product China - Executive Director
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
About the Position
As the Head of Trade & Working Capital (TWC) China and Head of Trade Product China, you will be responsible for driving the product strategy, development, maintenance and commercialization of the Supply Chain Finance (SCF) and Core Trade services that J.P. Morgan delivers to our clients out of China, reporting into the Global Core Trade Product Head as well as the APAC SCF Product Head. In addition, you will have P&L responsibility, assure proper solution sets are built across all segments, keep up to date with all market and regulatory items impacting the products, and assure day to day programs and service are managed. The role includes extensive collaboration with Sales, Operations, Service, Technology, Risk, Legal, Compliance and Legal.
Responsibilities
Help define product strategy to achieve enhanced capabilities, reduce risk, increase operational efficiency, and drive increased revenue in line with the Global Strategy.
Full P&L Ownership including delivery of revenue goals, achievement of expense targets, management of cost allocations and introduction of product-specific initiatives to measure/improve product profitability.
Assess current client portfolio and identify opportunities to tweak existing business flows to grow JPM wallet share from existing client base.
Anticipate internal and external factors impacting business and implementing plans to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
Work closely with the other product managers within the group and in other regions to provide integrated solutions to our clients. Structure and present reporting and updates to senior management

jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
Key Responsibilities
Inference Platform & Optimization: Build and optimize enterprise LLM serving platforms (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT-LLM) using techniques like PagedAttention, continuous batching, and quantization (AWQ/FP8) for high throughput and low latency.
GPU Pooling & AI Infra: Design GPU pooling, virtualization, and scheduling solutions on Kubernetes to maximize hardware utilization. Manage distributed training clusters and high-performance networking (RDMA/NCCL).
Model Deployment & MLOps: Streamline the CI/CD pipeline for AI models. Implement automated benchmarking, zero-downtime deployment, and comprehensive observability (TTFT, TPS, GPU metrics).
Qualifications
Education & Experience:
Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in Backend Systems, Distributed Systems, or AI Infrastructure/MLOps, with at least 1-2 years specifically focused on LLM serving, GPU optimization, or ML Systems.
Core Engineering & Systems Skills:
Expert-level proficiency in Python and strong proficiency in Java (essential for inference engines and CUDA integration).
Deep understanding of Linux internals, networking, and distributed systems architecture.
Hands-on experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker) and building custom K8s operators or controllers.
AI Infrastructure & Optimization Skills:
Deep familiarity with LLM inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI) and understanding of their underlying architectural designs. Or
Solid understanding of GPU architecture (NVIDIA Ampere/Hopper), CUDA programming, and GPU memory management. Or
Experience with distributed training frameworks (DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, Ray) and high-performance networking (RDMA, RoCE, InfiniBand).
Mindset & Soft Skills:
A "hacker" mindset with a passion for squeezing every drop of performance out of hardware.
Ability to collaborate effectively with AI Researchers (to understand their models) and Backend Engineers (to integrate AI into business systems).
Preferred
Contributions to open-source AI Infra projects (e.g., vLLM, Ray, PyTorch).
Experience writing custom CUDA kernels or using Triton for operator fusion.
Financial industry (Asset Management/Quant) experience is a plus.
Language: Professional working proficiency in English to collaborate with global teams.

jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
The Centralized Research Group (CRG) is a talent hub for banking teams across the globe. It is a part of JPMorgan Banking business. We work closely with the firm's Banking teams across the globe to provide research and analytical support, supporting bankers with customized intelligence on targeted companies, sectors and markets, analyzing potential business opportunities and preparing client marketing materials. These researches and analysis can relate to mergers & acquisitions, equity capital raising, debt capital raising or treasury solutions provided by the bank.
At CRG Shanghai, you will be closely integrated with Asia coverage banker teams. In-depth industry and capital market knowledge, financial analysis along with excellent communication and presentation skills will be the key skills to support Investment Bankers. CRG team members come from diverse educational backgrounds with strong academic performance and relevant work experience.
Job Responsibilities
Marketing materials and deal support: Work with colleagues in Shanghai and across regional locations to prepare marketing materials including market updates, pricing updates, earning summaries, case studies, peer benchmarking, target company profiles and benchmarking. Contribute on RFPs including industry landscapes, buyer / target screening and investor profiles. Also work independently and contribute to execution including but not limited to preparation of analyst presentations, management presentation, roadshow presentation, information memoranda, due diligence questionnaires and sales force memos
Financial analysis: Analysis and interpretation of financial statements including preparing trading and transaction comparables, and financial metric benchmarking for companies. Work on various types of financial analysis including ratings analysis, capital structure analysis and firepower analysis. Actively build and develop valuation and financial models
Research: Source and interpret company / industry information from a variety of data sources (company reports, Internet, online databases, J.P. Morgan proprietary content). Learn to develop views on specific industries and start tracking them for developments / potential opportunities
Industry or Product coverage: Work with colleagues in Shanghai and across regional locations to develop and apply industry / geographic market fundamentals (e.g. impact of economic/market conditions, competitive landscape, risks, trends) for clients across the globe. Also track a set of clients / emerging sectors / product themes with an aim to pitch potential ideas across M&A / ECM / DCM
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Bachelor/Master degree from a reputed college/institute
Strong communication skills (written as well as verbal) and an ability to precisely articulate thoughts
Intellectually inquisitive and highly motivated self-starter with problem solving mindset
Working knowledge of finance and accounting
Analytical aptitude and ability to learn new concepts
Close attention to detail and ability to deliver high quality output under pressure
Strong team player demonstrating integrity and ability to work with teams across geographies
Good language skills (Chinese and English) are essential, Korean/Japanese will be a plus

jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
Ready to be a key player in the world of fund management industry? As a part of Transfer Agent team, you will dive into the exciting world of fund operations, learning to cover transaction settlement and operation system maintenance that keeps our funds running seamlessly.
You will be expected to handle transaction settlement with precision, implement accurate system setup for business development and collaborate across teams to keep fund operation running like clockwork. This work matters because it's the backbone of how clients engage with our funds, building on their trust that contributes to long-term business success.
Job Responsibilities
To effectively process daily fund settlement and perform day end cash reconciliation, ensure no unexplained cash break.
Settlement account management (e.g. account opening, renewal and closure, record keeping and archive).
Setup static data in key operation systems (e.g. TA, ETF TA, Fund Settlement) to support smooth daily fund operation around the clock.
To work nightshift on TA day-end system processing (about once every week, from 9am to 11pm)
Collaborate with internal stakeholders and provide value-added operational support (e.g. regulatory data output, customized parameter table and respond to sales and client enquires)
To coordinate with stakeholders for projects related to innovative product development, system tests and process optimization according to business needs.
To communicate and resolve issues with external stakeholders such as distributors and vendors.
Duly carry out tasks according to Standard Operating Procedures and strictly observe firmwide professional conduct, proactively identify operation risks and prevent financial loss and reputational damage.
Other tasks assigned by supervisors.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Bachelor's degree or above in Business/Investment or IT related fields.
Around 8-10 years of relevant work experience in fund operation, cash settlement and clearance, holding certificate of China Asset Management Association.
Working experience on cross functional project management in large multinational company such banking group and asset management company.
Possess “can-do” attitude, excellent work ethics, be diligent and detail-oriented, have a strong sense of dedication and responsibility.
Proficient in Microsoft Office suite, including Word, Excel and Powerpoint.
Excellent communication and coordination skills, and with team-oriented spirit
Proficient in English workplace communication (IELTS score 7 or equivalent).
Quick learner and always adapt to fast changing environment, and be able to deliver results under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Overseas study and work experience is preferred.
Industry experience on managing ETFs and Mutual Recognition of Funds.
Proficiency in VBA or python coding
